fit.S1: 3 — Multiplicativity IS the axiom: randomness sits on the primes, and Harper's low-moment theorems are the only known unconditional technology converting pure multiplicativity into cancellation BEYOND the L²/orthogonality barrier — even for deterministic families (character sums mod r, zeta sums averaged over t, arXiv:2301.04390). DH sums cannot even be modeled (no Euler product). But the input is consumed only in ensemble/family average — never for a single L-function — so the DH filter is passed vacuously, not operationally.

Wintner 1944 is the canonical exhibit: RH holds a.s. in the model while nothing follows for mu.
